bridges.claim: The true foundation of humanistic equality, rights, and care for the weak is Jesus Christ, not mere atheist or theist behavior.
Human equality is not empirically self-evident; its Christian genealogy points to its metaphysical foundation.
Incarnation, cross, and eternal personal love supply a fitting ultimate good and privilege the vulnerable.
Evolutionary cooperation and in-group reciprocity do not supply the Christian ethic of enemy-love and protecting the weak.
Experienced obligations and outrage resist a merely private morality.
Jesus supplies a narrative framework for interpreting nonideal Old Testament rules.
